behavior: Hydrates Library search candidates through existing getLibraryMarkdownContent, which resolves tenant-scoped canonical item and rechecks read ACL before loading markdown_source.
Drops results when canonical updatedAt differs from indexed result updated_at, or canonical markdown is unavailable.
Computes SHA-256 over full canonical Markdown and binds source digest/revision in evidence while returning only a codepoint-safe prefix within maxContextTokens.
Stops further canonical reads when the remaining context budget is exhausted.

verification.command: JWT_SECRET=<local-test-secret> pnpm --filter @smartspec/web exec vitest run server/services/retrievalBroker.test.ts server/services/librarySearchService.test.ts server/routers/library.test.ts

security_boundary: Uses existing LibraryService tenant resolution and ACL enforcement. No caller-supplied tenant/user, database ownership, provider, index, schema, or dependency changes.
limitations: Quality gate remains uncertified; evidenceQuality remains weak and degraded.
Focused tests do not establish Production Verified.
No production provider/index verification or benchmark is claimed.
